CustomField.label: Offer Alert Last Interval
CustomField.description: Half of the call-for-offers alert idempotency marker (O2). Holds the SMALLEST alert interval CallForOffersAlertBatch has already notified for this deal, from the ladder 7 / 3 / 1 / 0 days before Offer Due Date. The batch fires only when the interval it would fire is STRICTLY SMALLER than this value, which makes the marker monotone: a missed run catches up on the next pass, and a double-run in one day is a no-op. Blank means no alert has been sent for the current Offer Due Date. Read with its partner Offer Alert Due Date - this field alone is meaningless, because a deadline that moves re-arms the whole ladder. Written by CallForOffersAlertBatch in system mode; blanking it by hand is the supported way to re-arm the alerts for a deal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the daily call-for-offers alert job. Clear this field to make the job send the alerts for this deal again.
